propositions: sonnet 4.6 and opus 4.8 share identical 1M input-token windows, so escalation from sonnet to opus gains zero additional context capacity
a context-limit retry after sonnet failure is guaranteed to fail identically at opus, but at higher pricing after a second round-trip
the failure is silent; operators misdiagnose it as 'even opus could not fit it' rather than 'escalation was a no-op', which is a larger harm than the wasted spend
new escalation_rungs() function must filter models_at_or_above() to skip rungs whose declared window is not strictly greater than the last kept rung's
both pass1_with_ladder and run_focused_finder must consume escalation_rungs() instead of models_at_or_above() to avoid the no-op paid call
models_at_or_above(), MODEL_LADDER contents, and largest_window_tokens remain unchanged to preserve provider-stickiness semantics and model-class vocabulary observables
